tools.name: rates_latest
tools.description: Today's exchange rates (forex reference rates, most recent ECB publication) for ~30 currencies in any base currency, e.g. USD to JPY, CNY, EUR, GBP, HKD, SGD, KRW, INR. Filter with symbols. Returns as_of date and source attribution. Price: $0.001 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one char

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Currency converter: convert an amount between any two of ~30 currencies (e.g. 100 USD to JPY) at the latest ECB reference rate or as of a past date. Returns rate, result and as_of date. Price: $0.001 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx err

tools.name: rates_historical
tools.description: ECB reference rates on a given date in any base; non-publication days fall back to the previous publication day (as_of). Price: $0.002 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).

tools.name: rates_timeseries
tools.description: Daily reference rate series for base/symbol between start and end (max 366 days), with min/max/mean and change. Price: $0.003 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).

tools.name: ai_gpu_prices
tools.description: Cloud GPU price comparison: hourly list prices of GPU / AI accelerator instances (H100, H200, A100, L40S, L4, A10G, T4, B200, MI300X, Trainium, Inferentia ...) on AWS and Azure in US, EU and Asia regions, on-demand and Azure Spot, ranked by USD per GPU-hour. Filter by gpu model, cloud, region, prici

tools.name: ai_llm_prices
tools.description: LLM API pricing lookup: USD per 1M input, output and cached-input tokens plus context window for ~3,300 models (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, xAI ...) across providers (direct, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, Together, Fireworks ...). Filter by model and provid

tools.name: macro_country
tools.description: Country economic profile: latest value and year plus annual history (2005 onward) for 21 World Bank World Development Indicators: GDP (USD), real GDP growth, GDP per capita, GNI per capita PPP, CPI inflation, unemployment, population, exports/imports % GDP, current account % GDP, central government

tools.name: macro_indicator
tools.description: Macroeconomic time series: one World Development Indicator (e.g. inflation_cpi_pct, gdp_growth_pct, central_govt_debt_pct_gdp) for up to 20 countries over a year range, annual values. See free /macro/indicators for keys. CC BY 4.0. Price: $0.01 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge

tools.name: macro_rank
tools.description: Country ranking: sort all economies by one World Development Indicator for a year (default: each country's latest value), highest first or lowest first, optionally filtered by World Bank region or income group. Aggregates (World, regions) excluded unless requested. CC BY 4.0. Price: $0.02 USDC per r
